```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import celltypist
from celltypist import models
import pandas as pd
```

```{python}
models.download_models(
    force_update=True, 
    model=["Immune_All_High.pkl"]
)
model_immune_high = models.Model.load(model="Immune_All_High.pkl")

models.download_models(
    force_update=True, 
    model=["Immune_All_Low.pkl"]
)
model_immune_low = models.Model.load(model="Immune_All_Low.pkl")
```

```{python}
adata = sc.read_h5ad("C:/Users/dan_m/oneDrive - University College London/documents/carPALL_scRNAseq_raw/carPALL_celltypist_input.h5ad")
adata
adata.X = adata.layers["logcounts"]
adata.var_names[:5]
adata.X
```

```{python}
results = []

for p in adata.obs["Patient"].unique():
    ad = adata[adata.obs["Patient"] == p].copy()

    # =========================
    # HIGH-RES MODEL
    # =========================
    pred_high = celltypist.annotate(
        ad,
        model="Immune_All_High.pkl"
    )

    ad_high = pred_high.to_adata(insert_conf=True)

    high_labels = ad_high.obs[["predicted_labels"]].rename(
        columns={"predicted_labels": "celltypist_high_label"}
    )

    # confidence = probability of assigned label
    high_conf = ad_high.obs[["conf_score"]].rename(
        columns={"conf_score": "celltypist_high_score"}
    )

    # =========================
    # LOW-RES MODEL
    # =========================
    pred_low = celltypist.annotate(
        ad,
        model="Immune_All_Low.pkl"
    )

    ad_low = pred_low.to_adata(insert_conf=True)

    low_labels = ad_low.obs[["predicted_labels"]].rename(
        columns={"predicted_labels": "celltypist_low_label"}
    )

    low_conf = ad_low.obs[["conf_score"]].rename(
        columns={"conf_score": "celltypist_low_score"}
    )

    # =========================
    # COMBINE
    # =========================
    df = pd.concat(
        [high_labels, high_conf, low_labels, low_conf],
        axis=1
    )

    df["patient"] = p
    df.index = ad.obs_names
    results.append(df)
```

```{python}
final_df = pd.concat(results)
```

```{python}
adata.obs = adata.obs.join(final_df)
```
